goal: Bounded one-hour matched dt60 RA4/RA37 diagnostic with 120-s full requested native IO including WW; report source state and failure diagnostics, not a 48-hour forecast claim.

native_output_contract.negative_hydrometeors: report only; no clipping or invented tolerance

pairing.required_adapter_mode_difference: RA37 requires frozen-optics mode 1 and the pinned table; RA4 requires mode 0 and empty table. This is an unavoidable scheme-support setting difference in addition to ra_lw/sw, not a pure single-factor radiation-scheme experiment.
